summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/operations/records/[recordId]/rollback POST route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before rollback writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: The unsafe rollback actorId case failed with HTTP 500 because the validly signed unsafe actorId reached later ownership lookup. The unsafe rollback sessionId case failed with HTTP 200 because the validly signed unsafe sessionId allowed a rollback write.

redGreenEvidence.command: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed rollback|lets the owning teacher roll back one teaching operation record"

behaviorHardened: Signed rollback cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed rollback cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before rollback audit events or operation-rollback domain projections can be written.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
